RWA.note: The notice states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
The notice states no government body using an AI system.
The notice states no AI tool in a sector's public system.

facts.fact: UNDP Rwanda, with the Rwanda Cultural Heritage Academy, tendered a consultancy (RFP UNDP-RWA-00409, published 18 Aug 2026) to prepare AI-ready Kinyarwanda text and speech datasets and a secure digital repository.

systems.system: Kinyarwanda AI-ready text and speech datasets
systems.platform: secure digital repository and metadata catalogue
systems.owner: Rwanda Cultural Heritage Academy with UNDP Rwanda

RWA.note: The notice names a data governance framework for language data only, a one-matter scope the study does not count as a national data policy.
